articles.title: USDT wins payments, USDC wins DeFi as stablecoins diverge: Dune
articles.snippet: Dune data shows Tether's USDT has become crypto’s dominant payments stablecoin while Circle's USDC powers DeFi, highlighting how blockchain choice shapes stablecoin use.

articles.title: AI Is Changing the Workplace and Universities Aren’t Keeping Up, Study Warns
articles.snippet: A University of Manchester researcher says schools should move beyond AI cheating concerns and prepare graduates for workplaces increasingly shaped by automation.
